entries.title: Noita

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Noita's sourced platform release is Microsoft Windows, so the Windows PC version is both the highest-fidelity and most-complete route. It also preserves the best capture/settings/modding flexibility for a streamed archive run.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Noita for Windows PC from Steam, GOG, Humble, or itch.io, update to the current build, and play the native PC release.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release; official 1.0 release after Early Access.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced platform release and best capture/settings route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate platform with exclusive gameplay content is documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or content-expanded edition is documented.
